solar_reference.interpretation: GR-like exterior lapse at the nominal solar photospheric radius; a necessary local benchmark for the weak-field branch, not a theorem that the full modified solution is exactly Schwarzschild
solar_reference.source: IAU 2015 Resolution B3 nominal conversion constants; c is exact SI

acceptance: compute the exact reference lapse N=sqrt(1-2GM/(Rc^2))
classify each frozen lambda anchor by the sign of R_DBI
prove analytically that at fixed N != 1 the formal lambda_D->infinity limit leaves the real static-clock DBI domain
interpretation_guard: B10 cosmological tail identifiability and this local reality-domain gate answer different questions; neither overwrites the other
non_claims: does not exclude alternative local branches with D_iSigma != 0 or nonzero invariant shift
does not solve the full solar metric
does not apply the weak-field photospheric estimate to neutron stars or black holes
does not establish compact-object regularity near X_U=0
